questions.question: Which provincial union holds the record for 'Highest Team Total' in the 08/09 season (combined T20 + List A)?

options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)

questions.question: At which ground did Vuyo Bonya record their career-best bowling figures (5-9, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at St George's Park, against Boland on 2024/03/02.

questions.question: Nonkululeko Mlaba is the only South African woman to ever take a 10-wicket match haul in Test cricket. What were her match figures, against England in December 2024?
questions.explanation: Mlaba took 4 for 90 and 6 for 67 (10 for 157 in the match) against England at Bloemfontein in December 2024, the best match figures by a South African woman in Test history.
